title: Deliver Task Outcome to the conversation handoff
outOfScope: Changing Task Outcome JSON schema or machine-truth generation semantics.
Changing Cockpit Status, cost metrics, status interface, archive, or closure semantics.
Authenticating human receipt, approval, or conversation identity.
Adding an agent runtime, scheduler, provider integration, or network transport.

reasons: User-visible governance output and fail-closed Outcome delivery require strict verification.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A successful ai-finish prints a clearly delimited active Outcome handoff to the CLI conversation stream.
A fail-closed ai-finish that persists a blocked Outcome prints that same truthful active Outcome handoff before returning non-zero.
The handoff is derived from the persisted Outcome and does not change machine-readable Outcome or report facts.
The handoff states that CLI output cannot authenticate human receipt or approval and preserves the explicit archive boundary.
Focused integration and end-to-end tests cover success, blocked failure, and the supported conversation language.
Outcome documentation describes the conversation/CLI handoff and its limitation.
guidelines: Render the conversation handoff only from the persisted validated Outcome.
Keep machine truth in Outcome JSON and derived Markdown; never infer receipt or approval from stdout.
Keep the archive transition explicit and separate from direct reporting.

intent.problem: Users can miss the Task Outcome in the conversation when ai-finish stops early on a failed gate because that path persists the blocked files but only emits a terse stderr message.
constraints: One Work Item, one branch, and one PR lifecycle.
Task Outcome JSON remains the sole machine truth.
CLI output is a delivery view, not proof of human receipt or approval.
intent.rationale: Making both success and fail-closed paths emit the same active Outcome handoff lets the conversation surface the decision facts without weakening governance or changing archive semantics.

rawUserRequest: Execute WI-05: reliably deliver Task Outcome/Human Benefit Report output to the conversation/CLI handoff, including fail-closed outcomes, without changing machine truth or governance semantics.

declaredIntent.summary: Deliver every active Task Outcome through the conversation-facing finish stream while preserving fail-closed governance.
